fields.name: discriminant
fields.explain: A fixed 8-byte tag the program checks first, so it can't mistake some other account for a market.

fields.name: status
fields.explain: The market's state: 1 means active (anyone can trade); others are post-only, paused or closed.

fields.name: bids_size
fields.explain: How many bid orders the bids tree has room for: the array is allocated at full size up front.

fields.name: asks_size
fields.explain: How many ask orders the asks tree has room for.

fields.name: num_seats
fields.explain: How many traders hold a seat, the permission to place orders on this market.

fields.name: base_decimals
fields.explain: SOL has 9 decimals: 1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports, the smallest unit.

fields.name: base_vault_bump
fields.explain: A number used to derive the vault's address; not needed to read the book.

fields.name: base_mint
fields.explain: The token being traded (base): this address is SOL.

fields.name: base_vault
fields.explain: The account that holds the market's SOL on behalf of its traders.

fields.name: base_lot_size
fields.explain: Lamports per base lot: order sizes are whole lots, so the smallest order is one lot.

fields.name: quote_decimals
fields.explain: USDC has 6 decimals: 1 USDC = 1,000,000 atoms.

fields.name: quote_vault_bump
fields.explain: A number used to derive the quote vault's address.

fields.name: quote_mint
fields.explain: The token prices are quoted in: this address is USDC.

fields.name: quote_vault
fields.explain: The account that holds the market's USDC.

fields.name: quote_lot_size
fields.explain: USDC atoms per quote lot, the unit fees and balances are counted in.

fields.name: tick_size_in_quote_atoms_per_base_unit
fields.explain: The price step: USDC atoms per whole SOL per tick, so prices are always whole numbers of ticks.

fields.name: authority
fields.explain: The key allowed to change the market's settings.

fields.name: fee_recipient
fields.explain: Where collected taker fees are sent.

fields.name: market_sequence_number
fields.explain: A counter that goes up with every instruction that changes the market: the difference between two snapshots counts what happened in between.

fields.name: successor
fields.explain: The key that would take over as authority if it were handed on.

fields.name: raw_base_units_per_base_unit
fields.explain: How many raw SOL units count as one 'unit' for pricing (1 here).

fields.name: header_padding
fields.explain: Reserved space, all zeros, so the header can grow without moving anything.

fields.name: market_padding
fields.explain: More reserved space between the header and the market's own fields.

fields.name: base_lots_per_base_unit
fields.explain: Lots per whole SOL: converts a size in lots into SOL.

fields.name: quote_lots_per_base_unit_per_tick
fields.explain: Quote lots per whole SOL per tick: converts a price in ticks into USDC.

fields.name: order_sequence_number
fields.explain: The next order's sequence number: every new order takes one, which is how time priority is decided.

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
fields.explain: The fee a taker pays, in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%) of the trade.

fields.name: collected_quote_lot_fees
fields.explain: All fees this market has collected so far, in quote lots.

fields.name: unclaimed_quote_lot_fees
fields.explain: Fees collected but not yet sent to the fee recipient.

fields.name: bids.root
fields.explain: Index of the red-black tree's root node (1-based; 0 would mean an empty tree).

fields.name: bids.tree_padding
fields.explain: Unused bytes that keep the allocator aligned.

fields.name: bids.allocator_size
fields.explain: How many nodes are in use right now: the number of resting bids.

fields.name: bids.bump_index
fields.explain: One past the highest node ever used: nodes from here on have never been touched.

fields.name: bids.free_list_head
fields.explain: The first deleted node waiting to be reused; each one points to the next.

fields.name: bids.node[1].left
fields.explain: Node 1 is a live resting bid. Index of the left child: the subtree of orders whose key sorts before this one.

fields.name: bids.node[1].right
fields.explain: Index of the right child: the subtree of orders whose key sorts after this one.

fields.name: bids.node[1].parent
fields.explain: Index of this node's parent (0 for the root).

fields.name: bids.node[1].color
fields.explain: Red-black colour (0 = black, 1 = red): the rule that keeps the tree balanced.

fields.name: bids.node[1].price_in_ticks
fields.explain: The order's price in ticks. 59,035 x $0.001 = $59.035 per SOL.

fields.name: bids.node[1].order_sequence_number
fields.explain: The order's sequence number. For bids Phoenix stores it bit-flipped (NOT seq, so the top bit is set): walking the tree from its largest key down then meets the highest price first and, within a price, the oldest bid first.

fields.name: bids.node[1].trader_index
fields.explain: Which seat placed this order (an index into the traders tree).

fields.name: bids.node[1].num_base_lots
fields.explain: The order's remaining size, in base lots. 1 x 0.001 SOL = 0.001 SOL.

fields.name: bids.node[1].last_valid_slot
fields.explain: The slot after which the order expires (0 = never).

fields.name: bids.node[1].last_valid_unix_timestamp_in_seconds
fields.explain: The time after which the order expires (0 = never).
